description: This file defines the LoginController class responsible for handling user login interactions in the OrangeHRM system. It prepares data and components for rendering the login page, manages authentication checks, and integrates various services like CSRF protection, theme customization, and social media authentication.

classes.name: LoginController
classes.description: Controller class handling login page display, preprocessing, and redirection for authenticated users in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getHomePageService
methods.description: Provides an instance of HomePageService, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares frontend component properties for the login page, including error messages, CSRF token, branding images, social media visibility, and login providers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming requests; redirects authenticated users to the homepage, otherwise processes the request normally.

methods.name: getProvidersList
methods.description: Returns a list of social media authentication providers configured for the login page.
